conditions.cell: Teflon divided cell, Nafion 117, 10 mL catholyte
conditions.procedure: same methodology as the nitrate runs, including 30 min at open circuit during deaeration (printed p. 124)

text_translated: Printed p. 125: increasing the supporting-electrolyte concentration hindered tin corrosion: in 0.1 M NaCl the tin concentration after 4 hours of electrolysis was 79 mg L-1, in 0.5 M NaCl about half (38 mg L-1); NaCl above 0.5 M did not reduce corrosion further. Related (printed p. 123): after 1 h in 2 M NaCl + 0.05 M NaNO3 dissolved Sn rose linearly from 28 mg/L (-1.8 V) to 258 mg/L (-2.8 V); at -2.4 V SnH4 was trapped in AgNO3 (3.5 ppm after 150 min, 50 ug total vs 2 mg cathode mass loss).
